_comment: Spec 010 / T004 — single source of truth for the Swedish UI strings used by the settings panel. Rust side (src-tauri/tests/settings_strings_drift.rs, future) and TS side (src/lib/settings-panel-strings.ts) both assert against this fixture in their drift-detection tests. Update all three together when changing a string. Helper sentences for the three tiers are pinned to Clarification Q3; appearance row strings to FR-013; About-section labels to FR-016 / FR-017.
